name: Discord
notes: Flathub wrapper for Discord's proprietary desktop client, available on x86_64 only. Requires explicit source approval and your own sign-in. Sandbox limits Game Activity, file access, and Rich Presence; no permission overrides, autostart, or account configuration are applied. On aarch64, explicitly skip this entry and use Discord in your browser.

name: Notion (Web)
notes: Official web app opened through an application-menu launcher in the configured default browser. Requires xdg-open, a supported browser, internet access and your own sign-in. No official native Linux desktop app or unofficial wrapper is installed; browser profiles and credentials remain untouched.

name: Docker Engine on Aurora DX
notes: User-approved replacement for Docker Desktop. Aurora DX supplies Docker Engine. On standard Aurora, run ujust devmode and follow its reboot prompts; then ujust dx-group and log out/in. Group access is root-equivalent. The setup checks the local Engine and never switches images, changes groups, or enables services automatically.

name: Kiro
notes: Official universal Linux tarballs. SHA-256 values were computed from the versioned vendor downloads. Kiro/bin/kiro is the CLI launcher and Kiro/kiro is the Electron desktop executable. The user-local install relies on unprivileged user namespaces for Chromium sandboxing because its chrome-sandbox helper cannot be installed root-owned setuid; --no-sandbox is not used.

name: Zed
notes: Official pinned Linux tarballs; computed SHA-256 values match the upstream release digests. zed.app/bin/zed is the CLI and desktop launcher; zed.app/libexec/zed-editor is the GUI executable. Requires a Vulkan 1.3 driver, glibc >= 2.31 on x86_64 or >= 2.35 on aarch64, and XDG FileChooser, OpenURI, and Secret or Secrets portals. Zed Agent terminal sandboxing additionally requires a non-setuid bwrap on PATH and working unprivileged user namespaces; without it Zed may warn and run agent commands unsandboxed. This setup does not install host packages or disable sandboxing.
